new_assertions.body: 4x4-k3 exhibits a genuine Q/D tradeoff: rank mod 3 is sufficient for scalar equivalence, while exact rank supports a simpler independent affine XOR evaluator.
The remaining 4x4-k4 and 5x3-k3 contradictions survive even when component values are indexed by exact rank, so they are not cross-rank aliases.
Any contradiction under exact-rank-disjoint valuation blocks is necessarily a same-exact-rank dependency; the next missing distinction lies within the component/context structure of that rank.
Q-V sufficiency of (M2,r mod 3,T2) does not imply an additive evaluator on that quotient; evaluator simplicity may require retaining an otherwise value-redundant rank coordinate.
The objective now has an explicit Pareto shape: coarser Q versus simpler D. No single representation should be called minimal without stating which combined cost is being minimized.
Interaction terms are still not justified generically; the smaller 5x3-k3 exact-rank failure should first yield an explicit dependency certificate.
